wrong_findings.claim: "The cafe's hours, phone and address appear as text on `/visit/` and `/contact/`."
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The `/visit/` page has hours and a general location, but no phone number; the phone number appears on `/contact/`.

wrong_findings.claim: `/coffee/java-ijen/` names "Java Ijen washed coffee, 250g", which doesn't match its on-page heading.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The schema name describes the same Java Ijen washed coffee as the heading, with the 250g variant specified; the page also lists a 250g size.

geo_advice.advice: Use H2 subheads in blog posts to structure content for AI answers.
geo_advice.quote: Blog posts use bold run-in labels where subheads (H2) would give structure for featured snippets and AI answers.

geo_advice.advice: Add a grind-size table and method-by-method sections to improve AI answer extraction.
geo_advice.quote: It is the sort of structured content AI answers quote.

geo_advice.advice: Add question-style H2s to guides for AI search readiness.
geo_advice.quote: The gains are the schema and entity work above, plus question-style H2s on guides.

extra_true.finding: `/coffee/` is a 102-word category page and links to only two coffees, omitting Flores.
Product schema omits some optional properties such as `url` and `sku`; each product page lists 250g and 1kg prices while its schema has one offer.
The site has no local business structured data; its cafe address is only in the `/visit/` footer, not the page body.
The sitemap entries have no `<lastmod>` values.
No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags appear in the page HTML.
No favicon link appears in the page HTML.
The pages have no visible breadcrumb navigation or BreadcrumbList markup.

notes: All 20 planted issues are identified with page-specific evidence and appropriate fixes. The total is approximate and counts distinct issue statements, not repeated mentions or generic best-practice suggestions.
